title: Israr Khan v. State of U.P. and Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Syed Qamar Hasan Rizvi, J.
disposition: Disposed; theft recovery withdrawn without deciding the dues.
headnote: Writ against a theft-of-electricity demand notice disposed of after the department stated that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after hearing, strictly under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. No clause was construed.
facts: Israr Khan challenged a 14 October 2022 demand notice for recovery of electricity dues in a theft case. Pursuant to an earlier Writ Court order he had objected to the provisional assessment, and he contended that the department never decided that objection before issuing a final assessment. On 15 February 2023 departmental counsel sought time to verify whether the objection had been decided. On 22 February 2023 counsel stated, on instructions, that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn and a fresh order would follow after hearing.

holding_units.topic: Disposal on withdrawal of theft recovery
holding_units.holding: The writ was disposed of on the electricity department's statement that the impugned recovery in a theft case had been withdrawn, with liberty to the respondents to pass a fresh order after hearing the petitioner, strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court did not construe any clause.

principle_tags.application: The docket is four short orders: two adjournments, a further adjournment to check whether the objection to provisional assessment was decided, and a disposal on counsel's statement that the theft recovery was withdrawn and a fresh order would follow after hearing under the Supply Code. No clause is construed.

not_decided.point: Whether the objection to the provisional assessment had been decided before the final assessment.
not_decided.note: Departmental counsel sought time to ascertain this; the recovery was then withdrawn without a finding.

not_decided.point: The legality and quantum of any fresh assessment of the alleged theft.
not_decided.note: Left to a fresh order after hearing, under the Supply Code procedure.
